`/work/fateh_013.lean` now compiles with no errors and no `sorry` warning. Two linter warnings remain: an unused `simp` argument and a `simpa` that could be `simp`. The imports and theorem statement are unchanged.

The proof follows the standard route:

1. **A Sylow subgroup.** Let U be the subgroup of upper unitriangular matrices `[[1, t], [0, 1]]`. It has order p. It lies inside some Sylow p-subgroup P. P also has order p, because p divides the order of GL₂(𝔽ₚ) exactly once, so P = U.
2. **The normalizer.** The normalizer of U has order p(p−1)². Every element of it has lower-left entry 0, which gives an injection into 𝔽ₚˣ × 𝔽ₚˣ × 𝔽ₚ. Conversely, every upper triangular matrix normalizes U, which gives an injection back the other way.
3. **The count.** The number of Sylow subgroups is the index of the normalizer. With |GL₂(𝔽ₚ)| = p(p−1)²(p+1), that index is p + 1.

The whole proof is inside the theorem, with no auxiliary lemmas or definitions outside it.
